cards.title: Top of the Ladder
cards.instruction: Carry yourself as the highest-status person present. Treat questions as requests for your approval.

cards.title: The Handoff Already Happened
cards.instruction: Get them to accept responsibility by returning to earlier offers until the task seems to have been assigned all along.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll decide how we handle this. Remember volunteering to finish the last detail of the fete?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You can question the details after my decision. The banner announces a raffle nobody has organised.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: And 'raffle' is the word still needing the most work.

mechanism: A treats B earlier limited offer as an already assigned broader responsibility, using authority to define its scope retrospectively.
confusable: Distinguish a new direct delegation from returning to specific earlier offered words as if those words already include the new job.
comparison: Wedding responses test the boundary of door duty; fete banner wording becomes responsibility for the event it advertises.
seedUse: Canonical invitation and banner seeds supply scope disputes; read their task ownership critically and use S01 through actual assignment rather than prefixes.
